treasurer_tax_search_form.extraction_potential: EXTREMELY HIGH. This portal exposes every bill in Greene County (paid+unpaid) since at least 2009 — 838K records. Recommend building a TCS adapter that scrapes the jqGrid XML pagination.

key_findings: ONLY 2 petition PDFs are directly retrievable from the live county website: 2023 and 2025. All others (2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022) require Wayback Machine — the old greenegovernment.com domain 301-redirects everything to the new homepage.

Of the 11 historical petitions found, only 3 have a text layer (2019, 2020, 2022 — all produced by the same Konica Minolta bizhub 368). The other 8 are image-only PDFs requiring OCR. Notably, the 2025 current petition was ALSO produced by the same bizhub but flattened to images-only.

The text-layer petitions (2019, 2020, 2022) reveal the consistent Schedule A schema: Parcel ID | Tax year & type | Current owner | Original Tax | Calculation base | Interest & penalties | Total due, grouped by SWIS (municipality). 2022 contains ~337 unique SBLs across 712 row-lines (multiple tax years per parcel).

No 2021 petition exists — the 2022 petition rolled in 2018-2020 delinquencies after the COVID-era resolution canceling Apr-May 2020 interest. No 2024 petition was filed (or it was rolled into 2025). No 2026 petition has been published yet (as of 2026-05-25).

Filename typo 'Forclosure' (missing the second 'e') is used in the 2025 URL. Other years vary: 2019/2020/2022/2023 use 'Foreclosure'; 2015/2017/2018/2019 use 'Petition-Notice-of-Foreclosure' (no 'and'); 2017/2023/2025 use 'Petition-and-Notice-of-Foreclosure'. Adapters/probes must test multiple spellings.

The Treasurer's Property Tax Search redirects to TCS (Total Collection Solution by Systems East), with COUNTY-DOCUMENTED public credentials (public@greene / public). The TCS portal exposes Entities, Bills, Payments grids via jqGrid XML endpoints. Bill grid alone contains 838,000 rows going back to at least 2009. This is a far richer tax-distress data source than the annual petition PDFs and is publicly accessible.
Auction vendor for foreclosed parcels is Absolute Auctions & Realty (AAR) at aarauctions.com / nysauctions.com — historical auction-results pages may exist on those sites but were not crawled here.
Final Judgment of Foreclosure documents are NOT published as PDFs on the Treasurer site — they would be filed with the County Clerk's record center.

BAS (egov.basgov.com), Info-Tax Online, NY Tax Glance handle town and school-district tax payments; school re-levies merge into the County Treasurer's TCS records once delinquent (per the property-tax-search page guidance).
recommendations_for_downstream_work: Continue using the 2025 petition as the primary tax_foreclosure_petition source — confirmed canonical, 29 pages, 584 parcels, image-only (OCR layer already in place per existing adapter).

For multi-year backfill: text-layer petitions (2019, 2020, 2022) can be parsed without OCR, yielding ~108 + 282 + 337 = ~727 historical distinct parcels worth of distressed-tax history with full owner+amount fields.

Image-only historical petitions (2015a, 2015b, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2023, 2025) all need OCR — same scanner-derived layout, same Schedule A column structure (per visual inspection); same OCR pipeline should work for all.

Build a TCS adapter targeting /bill/listXml with pagination (rows=500, sort by billNumber desc). 838K rows = ~1,700 pages. Filter to Status=Unpaid for delinquent leads. This will give continuously-fresh delinquent data without waiting for the annual petition.
Cross-reference TCS Entity.parcelId with the Schedule A 'Parcel ID' format (e.g., '122.10-2-18') to merge petition-level filing data with bill-level real-time amounts.
